_comment: Curated did_v1 -> V_eta migration TARGET map: for each v1 source class, the V_eta document class(es) its migrator actually emits. Extracted from the migrator headers + emitted document_class.class_name (superclasses excluded) + NDI second-pass functions, cross-checked against code. Consumed by tools/coverage.py to fill the ledger's target column. targets = pass-1 emitted classes; carried = pre-existing classes attached to (not minted); second_pass = classes minted in the NDI second pass; how = one-line authored intent; flags = caveats (dynamic emit, header/code mismatch, deferrals).

element.how: element becomes a subject (id PRESERVED) + kind term_assertion(s) (type, ndi_element_class) + a lineage directed_relation (derived_from underlying element, or observes the specimen)
element.flags: mints subject (id preserved); relation type dynamic (derived_from vs observes); part_of deliberately not emitted

element_epoch.how: element retired, so the epoch doc is renamed element_epoch -> acquisition_epoch

subject.how: carry-forward: guarantee a non-empty subject.local_identifier (now REQUIRED), else unchanged
subject.flags: passthrough of same class, id preserved

subject_group.how: group -> a bare subject (id preserved; is_group/is_biological removed) + one member_of directed_relation per member

openminds_subject.how: bundled openMINDS controlled-term (Species/Strain/GeneticStrainType/BiologicalSex) -> ONE term_assertion on the subject (carried); timeless
openminds_subject.flags: subject_assertion is the abstract superclass, excluded

openminds_element.how: bundled openMINDS entity about an element/device -> ONE term_assertion on the element-subject (carried); timeless

openminds_stimulus.how: bundled openMINDS entity about a stimulus -> ONE term_assertion on the stimulus-subject (carried); timeless

metadata_editor.how: opaque metadata_structure blob decomposes into first-class entities connected by directed_relations (has_author, affiliated_with, funded_by, issued_by, cites, documented_by)
metadata_editor.flags: per-subject projections (experimental_approach) not persisted; reads PascalCase fields by design

dataset_remote.how: remote copy -> a web_resource entity + a dataset -stored_at-> web_resource relation (+ organization + hosted_by relation when a remote org namespace is given)

dataset_session_info.how: legacy aggregate membership: a bare dataset + one session -part_of-> dataset edge per member session
dataset_session_info.flags: directed_relation best-effort (dropped when a member session is not in-batch)

session_in_a_dataset.how: session membership -> a bare dataset + a session -part_of-> dataset directed_relation
session_in_a_dataset.flags: directed_relation best-effort (dropped if member session doesn't resolve in-batch)

treatment.how: dispatched by data structure into ONE data-type-named subject_manipulation leaf + an optional site term_observation + session anchor
treatment.flags: DYNAMIC: exactly one of temperature/dose/term_manipulation per row; SECOND PASS: an attributed (co-anchored) site -> Path-S part-subject via pathSPromotion, retargeting the manipulation onto the part

treatment_drug.how: drug administration -> a dose_manipulation (chemicals from mixture_table) + an optional site term_observation + anchor
treatment_drug.flags: term_observation only when a location is present; SECOND PASS: attributed site -> Path-S part-subject

treatment_transfer.how: transfer act -> a term_manipulation on the recipient + a derived_from directed_relation (recipient <- donor) + anchor
treatment_transfer.flags: precise transferred-material part-subject reserved for a Path-S refinement (not implemented)

virus_injection.how: viral injection -> a dose_manipulation (virus as spine variable, dilution/titer as amount) + an optional site term_observation + anchor
virus_injection.flags: term_observation only when a site is present; SECOND PASS: attributed site -> Path-S part-subject

ontology_label.how: ontology label about an element/subject -> a term_observation (label term as value) + anchor; located-by-default
ontology_label.flags: Path-S promotion NOT applied (no co-anchored manipulation)

ontology_image.how: VINTAGE-AWARE. NDI redefined ontologyImage upstream, so two shapes are both did_v1. Vintage A (legacy: ontology_name + ontology_region, depends_on element_id) MIGRATES here -> term_observation ('imaged region') + anchor. Vintage B (current NDI production: ontology_nodes = a comma-joined CURIE list, depends_on ontologyTableRow_id, ngrid superclass) is DEFERRED to the NDI second pass and PASSES THROUGH UNCHANGED -- a table row is not a subject, so the subject is reachable only via the migrated-id graph
ontology_image.flags: guarded: errors (quarantines) on the V_delta `region` shape or any unknown shape rather than emitting a husk; the old `region` read matched NEITHER vintage (it is V_delta migrator output) and silently emitted an empty observation about nobody; vintage B passthrough requires the ontology_image tombstone to declare ngrid + ontology_nodes

ontology_table_row.how: each column of the legacy key/value table becomes its own statement: timeless facts -> term/date_assertion; timed numeric measures -> a data-type <dim>_observation chosen by value shape; recognised table signatures dispatch to a per-table map (JH encounter) minting a shared window + relations + subject
ontology_table_row.flags: DYNAMIC emit: leaf chosen per-column; nested read row.numeric_value deferred with D10/D11

probe_location.how: probe location -> a term_observation about the probe-subject (device-as-subject); value = atlas term (located-by-default) + anchor
probe_location.flags: Path-S promotion NOT applied (no co-anchored manipulation)

probe_geometry.how: ONE length_observation PER POPULATED SPATIAL AXIS about the probe-subject (probe_id) + an optional probe_model term_assertion + anchor. The real NDI class is three already-named parallel per-site arrays (site_locations_leftright/_frontback/_depth) with a shared `unit`, not an N-by-D matrix, so each axis keeps its own name instead of being concatenated into one anonymous array
probe_geometry.flags: guarded: errors on the invented channel_positions/position_units/probe_type shape. Those names never existed, so channel_positions never matched and EVERY document was carried through unconverted. STILL DROPPED: shank_id, contact_shape+width/height/radius, manufacturer, has_planar_contour, contour_x/y -- needs a contact-geometry model

position_metadata.how: no numeric coordinates here (FOLD B): a term_observation of the element-subject whose variable is 'position' and value is the measurement ontology_term + anchor
position_metadata.flags: numeric coordinates live in a separate element/timeseries doc; binding to the coordinate body is a Path-S/NDI second-pass job (not implemented)

distance_metadata.how: measured distance -> a length_observation of the element-subject + a 'during' session anchor
distance_metadata.flags: real v1 docs are flat with empty numeric_values -> carry-unchanged path (quarantine); length_observation fires only on the assumed-shape fixture; endpoint identities need a Path-S NDI second pass (NOT implemented)

electrode_offset_voltage.how: per-channel DC offset voltages -> a length-N voltage_observation on the probe-subject + anchor

site2channelmap.how: num_sites -> ONE inline count_observation (recording-site cardinality) on the probe-subject + anchor
site2channelmap.flags: the actual site->channel map deferred (instrument-layer/NDI second pass)

spike_interface_sorting_outputs.how: num_units -> ONE inline count_observation (sorted-unit cardinality) on the recording subject + anchor
spike_interface_sorting_outputs.flags: does NOT mint per-unit subjects (that is neuron_extracellular); sorter provenance dropped

neuron_extracellular.how: sorted unit -> a DERIVED subject (grain B, fresh id) + a derived_from directed_relation (unit <- recording subject) + a score_observation of sort quality + anchor
neuron_extracellular.flags: mints a NEW subject AND carries the recording subject; mean_waveform + cell-type term_assertion deferred

spike_clusters.how: per-spike cluster assignments -> a body-backed count_observation (n = num_spikes) + sampled_body + anchor
spike_clusters.flags: sorted units are separate neuron_extracellular docs

jrclust_clusters.how: per-spike cluster assignments -> a body-backed count_observation (integer label series) + sampled_body + anchor

spikewaves.how: extracted spike waveform snippets -> a body-backed voltage_observation (n = num_spikes) + sampled_body + anchor
spikewaves.flags: header title says dataseries_observation but code emits voltage_observation; extraction-params provenance deferred

binnedspikeratevm.how: binned spike-rate series -> a body-backed frequency_observation (a rate is a frequency) + sampled_body + anchor
binnedspikeratevm.flags: header title says dataseries_observation but code emits frequency_observation (explicit inline override)

pyraview.how: multi-resolution pyramid signal -> a body-backed voltage_observation + ONE sampled_body per stored resolution level + anchor
pyraview.flags: header title says dataseries_observation but code emits voltage_observation; multiple sampled_body (one per level)

image_stack.how: file-backed pixel blob -> a body-backed image_observation (geometry inline, storage_mode body) + sampled_body (frames) + anchor
image_stack.flags: image_observation and *_body are draft in V_eta; NDI imaging infra left to the NDI second pass

vmspikefit.how: r_squared -> a goodness-of-fit score_observation (fit_function as method) + anchor

fitcurve.how: generic curve fit -> a goodness-of-fit score_observation (fit_function carried as method) + anchor

vmneuralresponseresiduals.how: mean_residual -> an inline voltage_observation of the subject + a derived_from directed_relation (residual <- the vmspikefit) + anchor
vmneuralresponseresiduals.flags: directed_relation only when vmspikefit_id present; full residual trace -> body deferred

vmspikesummary.how: each summary scalar -> its own inline quantity observation classed by physical quantity (mean_vm->voltage, firing_rate->frequency, num_spikes->count, duration->duration) + one shared anchor
vmspikesummary.flags: one observation per PRESENT scalar; the four listed are the full candidate set

simple_calc.how: DEFERRED to the NDI second pass; PASSES THROUGH UNCHANGED. The real NDI template is {input_parameters, answer} with a single document_id edge pointing at the INPUT DOCUMENT and an `app` parent -- there is NO subject-bearing edge and NO units field at all. The previous migrator read result_value/result_units (V_alpha inventions), so the unit-dispatch had nothing to dispatch on and, both reads failing, it emitted only a bare session anchor -- the result was dropped
simple_calc.flags: guarded: errors on the invented result_value/result_units shape rather than emitting a subjectless observation; passthrough requires the simple_calc tombstone to declare base+app, document_id, answer, input_parameters

contrast_tuning.how: result class -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved 1->1; element_id -> subject_id; result composite kept verbatim) + session anchor
contrast_tuning.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

orientation_direction_tuning.how: result class -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved 1->1; element_id -> subject_id; result composite kept verbatim) + session anchor
orientation_direction_tuning.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

spatial_frequency_tuning.how: result class -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved 1->1; element_id -> subject_id; result composite kept verbatim) + session anchor
spatial_frequency_tuning.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

temporal_frequency_tuning.how: result class -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved 1->1; element_id -> subject_id; result composite kept verbatim) + session anchor
temporal_frequency_tuning.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

speed_tuning.how: result class -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved 1->1; element_id -> subject_id; result composite kept verbatim) + session anchor
speed_tuning.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

stimulus_presentation.how: NO pass-1 migrator; assembled ENTIRELY in the NDI second pass into ONE body-backed visual_grating_manipulation on the animal (resolved via stimulus_response->element->subject) + a sampled_body of one record per trial
stimulus_presentation.flags: returns [] (leaves presentation as-is) when no animal responded

stimulus_bath.how: DEFERRED in pass 1 (errors needsSessionContext); assembled downstream (resolveDeferredBaths / ndi.migrate.local) into a dose_manipulation once the stimulator element's subject + epoch anchor resolve
stimulus_bath.flags: pass-1 migrator always errors (intentional deferral); NDI stimulusBathToBath still targets retired `bath` for V_zeta/V_epsilon (task #20)

daqreader_ndr.how: ndr subtype dissolves into generic daqreader; ndr_reader_string -> reader_string, ndi_daqreader_ndr_class dropped

daqreader_mfdaq_epochdata_ingested.how: mfdaq subtype de-encodes into the generic ingested cache; parameters moves onto the parent as optional field

contrast_sensitivity_calc.how: aggregate calculator OUTPUT (flat matrices on its own block) -> contrast_sensitivity_calculation (HAS element_id -> single-doc; sourceBlock is the concrete *_calc block; input_parameters -> method_parameters) + session anchor
contrast_sensitivity_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

contrast_tuning_calc.how: calculator OUTPUT -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved; input_parameters -> method_parameters; app kept; raw input -> derived_from_1) + session anchor
contrast_tuning_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

hartley_calc.how: DEFERRED calculator: calcCommon passthrough, class retained
hartley_calc.flags: calculators deferred (conversion doc exists but no decomposition migrator)

oridirtuning_calc.how: calculator OUTPUT -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved; input_parameters -> method_parameters; app kept; raw input -> derived_from_1) + session anchor
oridirtuning_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

spatial_frequency_tuning_calc.how: calculator OUTPUT -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved; input_parameters -> method_parameters; app kept; raw input -> derived_from_1) + session anchor
spatial_frequency_tuning_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

speed_tuning_calc.how: calculator OUTPUT -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved; input_parameters -> method_parameters; app kept; raw input -> derived_from_1) + session anchor
speed_tuning_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

temporal_frequency_tuning_calc.how: calculator OUTPUT -> the tuning_curve_calculation subject_calculation LEAF (id-preserved; input_parameters -> method_parameters; app kept; raw input -> derived_from_1) + session anchor
temporal_frequency_tuning_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

tuningcurve_calc.how: IS-A stimulus_tuningcurve so inherits a populated element_id -> single-doc fold to tuning_curve_calculation (result on the inherited stimulus_tuningcurve block; input_parameters -> method_parameters) + session anchor
tuningcurve_calc.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)

epochclocktimes.how: superclass block migrator: rewrites the epochclocktimes block in place (clocktype->epoch_clock, t0_t1->t0/t1); no class change
epochclocktimes.flags: in-place block rewrite, emits no new document

filter.how: superclass block migrator: renames filter.type->filter_type in place; no class change
filter.flags: in-place block rewrite, emits no new document

ngrid.how: superclass block migrator: rewrites ngrid block (data_dim->dim_sizes, adds ndims) in place; no class change
ngrid.flags: in-place block rewrite, emits no new document

stimulus_tuningcurve.how: raw ndi.app.stimulus.tuning_response curve -> tuning_curve_calculation (element_id -> subject_id; result verbatim; no calc input_parameters/app) + session anchor
stimulus_tuningcurve.flags: calculator composite-leaf fold (Lepsky et al.); un-defers with 0 orphans (id-preserved)
